title: Port the test-suite hygiene guard

epic.name: Async test suite through dependency injection

story.i_want_to: a test that fails when a sync module has no stated reason or a test writes global state

rationale: home_care_billing's test/home_care_billing/test_suite_hygiene_test.exs (PR #2272) does this; without it every conversion here decays.

acceptance_criteria.description: A module running sync and not on the guard's allow-list with a reason fails the suite.
Writes to application env, OS env, Logger config or levels, persistent_term and Mox global mode fail the suite.
Async DDL or LOCK TABLE on a table an app schema uses fails the suite.
The allow-list holds only the legitimately sync modules below, each with its reason.

test_cases.name: Guard catches a regression
steps: Add async: false to a module not on the allow-list
expected_results: The guard fails naming the module

technical_notes: Legitimately sync: a module whose SUBJECT is the shared thing (CLAUDE.md, Test Conventions rule 1) - committed transactions racing on independent connections, a lock or write held by a second connection, migration or fault-injection DDL on a shared table, committed-corpus scale and plan tests, the pgbouncer and e2e journeys, and the lock guard's own test. The list itself, each entry with its reason, is @sync_allowed in test/loopctl/test_suite_hygiene_test.exs; it is not repeated here because it changes with every conversion.
